significance: A Shiva temple inside Vellore Fort at the centre of the city, raised in 1550 by the Vijayanagara chieftain Chinna Bommi Reddi during the reign of Sadasiva Raya. It is noted for a nine-tier gopuram, richly carved stone pillars, monolithic sculpture and heavy wooden gates.
story: The lingam is said to have stood self-manifested within a great anthill ringed by standing water, which gave the god his name from jalam, water.
